test_mlp_epinet: test the MLP epinet with configurable base hidden layers, epinet hidden layers, index dimension, and regression mode
run_epinet_test: run the EpinetTest class to validate MLP epinet functionality across multiple parameterized configurations
create_test_experiment: create a supervised test experiment for regression or classification tasks using make_test_experiment
build_mlp_epinet: build an MLP epinet with specified output sizes, epinet hidden layers, and index dimension
train_experiment: train the experiment with the MLP epinet for a specified number of steps
